approach: 24h simulation used as ground truth; held-out scenarios S07/S08 for validation

interpretation.MAE: Average prediction error in % risk — lower is better. <10% is good.
interpretation.RMSE: Penalizes large errors more than MAE — lower is better.
interpretation.MAPE: Error relative to actual value (%). <20% is acceptable.
interpretation.R2: 0=no explanation, 1=perfect. Above 0.6 is good for forecasting.
interpretation.hit_rate: Of all real dangerous moments, what % did AI detect? Must be high.
interpretation.miss_rate: Of all real dangerous moments, what % did AI MISS? Must be 0%.
interpretation.false_alarm_rate: Of all safe moments, what % did AI falsely alarm? Should be low.
interpretation.directional_acc: Did AI predict if risk goes UP or DOWN? >60% is better than random.
interpretation.band_coverage: Is actual value inside 95% confidence range? Should be ~95%.
